implementation.name: TV80
implementation.notes: License: MIT, read from https://github.com/hutch31/tv80/blob/master/LICENSE, which is the verbatim MIT permission and warranty text (as comment lines, with no separate copyright line). accuracy_id from the README: the core "aims to be an area efficient core which closely mimics the original operation and cycle timing of the Zilog Z80". is_top is rtl/core/tv80s.v per the README ("The top level wrapper is the tv80s"). Originally an OpenCores project, ported from the T80 VHDL sources.
